card.name: Limits on use frequency or amount
card.fires_on: Words that set a limit or caution on use, such as frequently, above, less or more than, in dosing restrictions. Also partway through words like crushed, discontinuing and undiagnosed in warnings.

modes.label: Comparative limit words
modes.description: Words like frequently, above, less or than that mark a threshold of dose, frequency or interval.
modes.example: if used more<< frequently>> than recommended, abrupt discontinuation or rapid

modes.label: Partway through warning verbs
modes.description: The middle of words like crushed, discontinuing, undiagnosed in instructions on what not to do.
modes.example: THE CONTENTS OF THE Verapamil Hydrochloride Extended-release Capsules (PM) CAPSULE SHOULD NOT BE CR<<USH>>ED OR CHEWED.

card.writes: Possibly pushes toward words meaning any or too much, as in a limit on use.
card.plain: It lights up in wording that sets limits or warns against doing something more, more often, or at all.
